// Positive control (#5170): a gate verb entry that returns a numeric exit itself.
import { declareGateExit } from './gate-exit.cjs';

export function cmdFixtureVerb(passed: boolean): number {
  declareGateExit({ outcome: passed ? 'pass' : 'block' }, 'status');
  if (!passed) return 1;
  return 0;
}
